operations.description: Inspect actual renderer/export format support. comparisonTimeWebmExport reports fixed-frame VP8 encode/decode API support separately (codec configuration checked on export); comparisonWebmExport remains realtime orbit/deformation. Single-view mp4 remains unsupported; formats.gif and singleOrbitGifExport retain bounded orbit GIF canvas support; singleStoredTimeGifExport separately reports nearest-stored thermal/acoustic time GIF support. Comparison-only comparisonGifExport reports orbit/time/deformation GIF support separately and a MediaRecorder MP4 probe only changes the reason. formats["png-sequence"] reports the fixed-frame ZIP export {supported,container:"zip",compression:"store",minFrames,maxFrames,defaultFrames,maxFrameBytes,maxTotalBytes,animations}.
limitations: Argument envelope only; runtime validation remains authoritative.
